completion_data.completion_summary: Phase 5 of ten landed: the forward-slack regime's baseline is compiled as free (hasForwardSlack_zero) and its two transports shown exact, with hasForwardSlack_raise_of_zero as the composite that needs no slack hypothesis; the phase's earlier blocker was withdrawn as mis-anchored and recorded as a win. The depth-0 cell obligation stays neither proved nor refuted and the reserved name stays claimed by nothing; Phase 8's idle-gap gate is now the only remaining candidate source of slack.

memory_candidates: A Lean plan that pins one lemma's position ('immediately after X') and only a section for a lemma consuming it can specify an impossible forward reference; resolve inside the plan's wording by honoring the pinned position and placing the consumer after its dependency in the same section, rather than treating it as a plan deviation.

An axiom-profile pin written from a plan's PREDICTED profile fails #guard_msgs when the measured profile is strictly smaller; measure first with lean_verify, and note the #print axioms docstring wraps across lines only when the profile list is long enough to wrap.

In this repository every .lean-touching commit must carry a regenerated typst/generated/status.typ: the pre-commit typst-sync gate compares committed line counts against a live regeneration, so a library edit needs 'typst-sync-check.sh --fix' before git-commit-scoped.sh will land.
